source: eqlwiki.com — the "Notable NPCs" row of each zone page infobox (rendered, not wikitext: the roster is generated by {{Special:DynamicZoneList}}). A zone with no row is absent here. `outOfEra` is the wiki's own action=eqlmetadata verdict and is recorded ONLY when true: a false answer is returned both for classic content and for a page nobody classified, so it is silence rather than evidence of being in era (scrape-page-era.ts states this at length).
